We are looking for a sorter of medical samples for a company active in the pharmaceutical sector. The company is located in Zaventem. As a sample sorter you are responsible for organizing, tracking, and distributing samples used in research, testing, or clinical trials.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You receive the routed samples and place them in the appropriate conditions (-20°C and -70°C freezers). 
 
• You perform simple inventory tracking procedures. 
 
• You do a quality check. 
 
• You communicate issues and keep a clean work space. 
 
• You work in a safe and timely manner.
 

Your profile:

 

 
• You like routine and precise work. 
 
• You have good spoken and written understanding of English. 
 
• You can follow strict procedures. 
 
• You can follow a certain work rhythm and have no issue with KPI's 
 
• You have a sense of responsibility because you handle important samples. 
 
• You can work easily with a computer. 
 
• You can work in a 3 week rotation (Mon-Fri/ Tue-Sat). 
 
• You are open to work on bank holidays.

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 

the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 

sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 

develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)

Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 

optimization

That's why this job suits you:

ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:

• Control systems for robotics

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

• Diagnosing issues using STAR and MANCATS diagnostic systems
• Performing maintenance tasks on trucks
• Dismantling and/or removing certain parts
• Customizing for specific assignments
• Taking care of customer vehicles and ensuring customer satisfaction

• A higher education in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience
• Experience with diagnostic tools.
• Good English knowledge.
• Knowledge of general mechanics (or automotive mechanics), metalwork (welding), and basic electrical knowledge
• Team player but can also work independently
• Works accurately, are solution-oriented, and flexible to customer needs

EDR Antwerp Shipyard is the largest shipyard in Belgium, specialised in ship maintenance and repairs, hull treatment and marine construction. Challenging activities require skilful and motivated team members. Over 150 vessels annually are repaired and maintained at our shipyard in Antwerp, and projects are performed on board vessels across the world.
 

As a 
Crane Operator, you play a key role in ensuring safe, efficient and well organised lifting operations within and around our dry dock. You will primarily operate one of our 
five cranes and support a wide range of dockside activities that contribute directly to vessel repair and maintenance projects. You will join a close knit team of experienced crane operators where teamwork and safety are central.
 

RESPONSIBILITIES
 

• Operate one of the 
five cranes on site, including a Wolff tower crane, a Wolff luffing jib crane and three fully restored shipyard cranes with lifting capacities of up to 100 tonnes
 

• Carry out lifting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with site procedures and operational requirements
 

• Support signalling and guidance of lifting movements in areas with limited visibility or restricted access
 

• Assist with dry dock operations (such as the positioning of docking blocks)
 

• Actively support crane operations by maintaining clear lifting zones, monitoring traffic routes and minimising downtime
 

• Coordinate incoming materials and deliveries, ensuring safe and appropriate storage locations are assigned
 

• Serve as a communication link between subcontractors, shipyard teams, vessel crews and fellow crane operators
 

• Provide basic rigging support and assist colleagues in selecting and using suitable lifting equipment
 

• Maintain good order, cleanliness and safety standards around the dry dock area
 

• Identify, report and document damage, deviations and unsafe situations
 

• Support other operational activities on site when crane work is temporarily unavailable

• Good knowledge of English, which is the primary language used for operational communication, radio contact and coordination with subcontractors and vessel crews
 

• Knowledge of Dutch is an advantage for internal coordination and site instructions. Knowledge of Polish and/or Romanian is considered a strong asset
 

• Strong safety awareness and the ability to maintain oversight and prioritise effectively in a dynamic work environment
 

• Confident communicator with a practical and collaborative approach
 

• Hands on attitude and a consistent commitment to agreed procedures and safety standards
 

• Experience with crane operations, forklifts and/or mobile elevated work platforms is highly advantageous
 

• Flexibility to align working hours (daytime hours) with operational requirements, deliveries and lifting schedules
 

• Weekend work may occur, but is not mandatory and will be arranged in consultation with the other colleagues

We are looking for a logistic operator for warehouse in Vilvoorde. The company is active in the medical field. You will join the kitting team and provide support to clinical supplies operations and administrative activities in all areas of clinical supplies lifecycle of low to moderate complexity studies.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You support logistics and administrative tasks related to clinical supplies and medical devices. 
 
• You ensure smooth processes for ordering, storage, labelling, shipping, and returns. 
 
• You track inventory levels and expiration dates, and prepare monthly reports. 
 
• You ensure all activities follow guidelines and internal procedures. 
 
• You maintain accurate data in electronic systems for the assigned studies. 
 
• You perform routine tasks and prepare the kits for the labs. 
 
• You handle ad-hoc supply purchases when needed. 

Your profile:

 

 
• You have a good command of English (spoken and written). 
 
• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a warehouse environment. 
 
• You are comfortable using computers and electronic equipment. 
 
• You are able to sit for 4–6 hours per day. 
 
• You can lift light objects (up to 7–9 kg). 
 
• You have a solid knowledge of clinical supply processes (e.g. manufacturing, shipping, labeling, auditing). 
 
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office. 
 
• You pay close attention to detail and quality-focused. 
 
• You are available for at least a month. 
 
• You can work from 7h30 - 15h36 OR 14h - 22h.

What does the role involve?
 

 
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
 
• You precisely measure materials.
 
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
 
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key. 

Profile – What do we expect from you?
 

 
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
 
• Good spatial awareness.
 
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
 
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
 
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

• You install and assemble sprinkler pipes according to plan.

• You correctly connect sprinkler systems.

• You perform inspections and pressure tests on the systems.

• You often work at heights, following the appropriate safety measures.

• Motivation and accuracy are what you work with.

📍 Location: Brussels, Belgium

🏢 On-site: Up to 5 days/week on-site required

🌍 Languages: Fluent Dutch or French (C2) + English (C1)

💰 Rate: 65-70/h
Overview
We are looking for a senior System Engineer with extensive experience in large-scale enterprise environments to manage, maintain, and evolve a complex endpoint infrastructure supporting more than 100,000 endpoints and 1,000+ applications. You will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and continuous improvement of the endpoint ecosystem across multiple platforms.
Key Responsibilities

* Manage and support desktops, laptops, smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, and industrial devices.

* Design, implement, and maintain endpoint and backend infrastructure solutions.

* Perform upgrades, migrations, deployments, and infrastructure enhancements.

* Conduct technical feasibility studies and recommend optimal solutions.

* Ensure infrastructure stability, security, and compliance.

* Provide 3rd line support and participate in on-call activities when required.

* Act as a technical advisor for business and IT stakeholders.

* Maintain accurate technical documentation and share knowledge across teams.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in System Engineering or Endpoint Infrastructure.

* Experience in enterprise environments with:

* 100,000+ endpoints

* 1,000+ software packages

* Experience working within ITIL-driven organizations.

* MCSA, MCSE, MCSD or equivalent Microsoft certification.

To find out more about Huxley please visit www.huxley.com

Your new role

As a Senior Support/ System Engineer, you will take on a broad and hands-on position combining System Engineering, Microsoft 365 administration and 1st, 2nd and 3rd line support. This is not a purely infrastructure-focused role. You enjoy being close to users and are willing to remain actively involved in support activities, including first-line support.

Your responsibilities include:

• Providing 1st, 2nd and 3rd line IT support to users across Europe

• Troubleshooting hardware, software, Microsoft 365 and infrastructure-related incidents

• Managing and administering Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Windows and endpoint devices

• Coordinating onboarding, offboarding and user access requests

• Handling incidents, service requests, problems and changes within an ITIL-based environment

• Working with Jira and Confluence for ticket management, documentation and knowledge sharing

• Supporting the rollout and further adoption of Jira and Confluence within the organization

• Collaborating with external IT vendors and service providers

• Contributing to IT projects, operational improvements and technical documentation

• Providing backup and support to colleagues within the team

The role is based in Waterloo and includes occasional travel to European offices, approximately once per month.

 

Your profile

To succeed in this role, you combine strong technical expertise with a service-oriented mindset. You have:

• Language skills are essential: Dutch and English are fluent, and ideally a good level of French

• A bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience

• At least 5 years of experience as a System Engineer, IT Support Engineer or similar position

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID and Windows environments

• Experience across 1st, 2nd and 3rd line support environments

• Previous experience working with Jira as a ticketing or IT service management platform

• Experience using Confluence for documentation and knowledge management

• Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management principles

You are independent, approachable, flexible and comfortable working in a flat organization where collaboration and mutual support are key.

 

What you'll get in return

• Permanent full-time contract

• Gross salary between EUR4,000 and EUR5,000, depending on experience

• Company car with fuel card (Europe)

• Group insurance and hospitalization insurance

• Extra-legal pension plan

• Performance-related bonus

• Homeworking allowance and internet compensation

• Laptop setup including screen, docking station, webcam and headset

• Training opportunities relevant to your role

• Flexible working hours

• Up to 1-2 days of homeworking per week

• Modern working environment with cafeteria and fitness facilities

• Exposure to international IT operations and cloud technologies

 

What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV!

Position: Sales Operations Representative / Order Administrator 

Location: Brecht 

As a Sales Operations Representative / Order Processor, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth order processing and customer satisfaction. You will follow up on orders, report and resolve incidents, and communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments. We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master with strong IAM knowledge to join an Identity Governance (IGA) programme at one of our clients in the financial sector.

 

Your role

You'll drive agile delivery for a team of IAM Business Analysts and SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) engineers. You'll run sprints, backlog refinement and all Scrum ceremonies, and act as the link between the team and its business, security and audit stakeholders. You'll keep delivery on track, surface dependencies early, and make sure priorities stay aligned across the programme.

 

What makes you the right fit

You understand IAM concepts well enough to engage with the team on substance: Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes, access recertification, access requests and application onboarding. You can challenge estimates, spot cross-team dependencies and anticipate risks.

 

Your profile

• PSM or CSM certification

• Several years of experience as a Scrum Master in IT security or IAM programmes

• Experience in the banking or financial services sector is a strong advantage

• Exposure to SailPoint (IdentityIQ / IdentityNow) is a strong plus

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English

Nice to have

• Experience taking on project lead responsibilities on infrastructure topics

-

We are looking for a Functional IAM Business Analyst to join an Identity Governance (IGA) team at one of our clients in the financial sector. This isn't a generic BA role. You'll work at the heart of access governance, shaping how people get, keep and lose access across the organisation.

 

Your role

You'll define and improve the processes that govern who gets access to what. That includes access request flows, periodic recertification campaigns and Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes. You'll make sure these controls are robust enough for internal audit and regulators. You'll also follow up on control findings and translate them into concrete process improvements.

 

Making access simpler

Your "customers" are internal users: a manager reviewing 200 access rights, or an employee requesting the access they need to do their job. Your goal is to make those journeys simpler and less painful, without compromising compliance.

 

Your profile

• Several years of experience as a Business Analyst in IAM or IT security

• Experience in banking or insurance is a strong advantage

• Hands-on functional experience with an IGA tool. SailPoint IdentityIQ is a big plus; Saviynt or Oracle Identity Manager are also relevant

• Solid knowledge of access reviews and certifications, RBAC and role models, Segregation of Duties (SoD) and least privilege

• Familiarity with banking regulation and control expectations (DORA, ECB/NBB, internal audit findings)

• At ease working with business stakeholders, audit and compliance teams

• Fluent in French or Dutch, plus English

-

jobs.occupation: Web Content Management Engineer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL
 Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
• Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
• Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
• Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
• Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
• Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies.
 

 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

• Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
• 3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
